description: This file contains utility functions and classes for data handling in PyTorch, including validation, file path utilities, and a StreamWrapper class for managing file streams.

classes.name: StreamWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps file objects to ensure proper closing and manage stream hierarchies.

methods.name: validate_input_col
methods.description: Checks if a function is compatible with a given input column, ensuring argument counts and types match.

methods.name: match_masks
methods.description: Matches a filename against a mask or list of masks.

methods.name: get_file_pathnames_from_root
methods.description: Recursively or non-recursively retrieves file pathnames from a root directory matching specified masks.

methods.name: get_file_binaries_from_pathnames
methods.description: Yields file pathnames along with a wrapped file object for binary or text modes.

methods.name: validate_pathname_binary_tuple
methods.description: Validates that a tuple contains a valid pathname string and a file-like object.

methods.name: _deprecation_warning
methods.description: Issues a warning about deprecated API usage.
